title: Crediting the Payment on the Day It Arrives: Partial Payments, Suspense, and the Late Fee an AI Servicing Agent Must Never Create
summary: A mortgage payment credited a day late, or a partial payment parked in suspense that triggers a delinquency, or a late fee charged on an unpaid late fee, each violates Regulation Z's payment-handling rules and each is the kind of error an automated cashiering flow produces at scale. Where an AI servicing agent applies payments under 12 CFR 1026.36(c), how suspense is supposed to work, and the date-stamp decision that prevents a phantom late fee.
